name: input
behavior: None — native <input> semantics (no APG pattern; labeling/description via field composition)

parts.statesNote: hover uses field-border-hover/field-surface-hover; invalid swaps field-border for status-critical per states.md

parts.note: leading adornment (icon or short text) — shadcn InputGroup addon, Salt startAdornment
the native input element; placeholder renders in content-secondary
trailing adornment — shadcn InputGroup addon, Salt endAdornment

anatomyNotes: Parts are invariant across themes. Salt's flush (bottom-border-only) field is a RECIPE difference on the root part (field-border applied to border-bottom only) — not different anatomy. A bare input without adornments is the same anatomy with the optional slots absent (shadcn Input vs InputGroup is composition, not a second component).
